This E log book also reflects my patient-centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 17px;\"\u003E40 yr old male , driver by occupation presented to the opd with the chief complaints of-\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 17px;\"\u003E• SOB since 4 days (grade 3-4)\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 17px;\"\u003E• pedal oedema since 4 days \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 17px;\"\u003E• cough since 4 days \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 17px;\"\u003E• abdominal distention since 4 days\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 17px;\"\u003E• decreased urine output since 4 days even after taking spironolactone.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 17px;\"\u003EHOPI:\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 17px;\"\u003EHe was apparently asymptomatic 3yr back.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 17px;\"\u003EThe patient is a chronic alcoholic and had similar complaints every time he presented to our hospiatl opd partly due to not taking medication and continuing drinking.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 17px;\"\u003EWas on intermittent medication of cardivilol.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 17px;\"\u003E14\/6\/2019\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 17px;\"\u003EHe presented with pedal oedema(till knee joint)(pitting type),\u0026nbsp; decreased urine output and SOB with orthopnea to our opd and was admitted. He was diagnosed with dialated cardiomyopathy( DCMP), mitral regurgitation and ejection fraction of 40% . \u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 17px;\"\u003ETreatment given : ramipril 25mg, lasix 40mg and aldactone50mg.\u003C\/span\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 17px;\"\u003ETime in between:\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 17px;\"\u003EHe visited local RMP every time he had the above symptoms and was using carvedilol and spironolactone for relieving his pedal edema.\u003C\/span\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 17px;\"\u003E20\/4\/2021\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 17px;\"\u003EPresented to the opd of our hospital with abdominal distention, SOB, pedal edema since 6 days.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: 17px;\"\u003EAnasarca was present. Further diagnosed with mitral sub mitral aneurysmal posterior annulus. Treatment given:tab cardivas and dytor plus.
